meanings.en: to approach, to come up; to suit
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (root 'ходить'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to approach', forming an aspectual pair with 'подойти'.
